scenario: The negative half of the DOMAIN row, on the same program and steps as LERR.1.4.9.negative_shift_is_a_computation_error. `type_error` is forbidden because the value is present and correctly typed — the ComputationError / TypeError split is about whether the OPERATION was valid at the site, not about whether it produced an answer — and `engine_error` because the engine stays intact. `rule_fire_begin` is forbidden too: rung 6 abandons the activation.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    x: Int mutable
    n: Int mutable

rule r:
    S s where (s.x << s.n) > 1
->
    log info "fired"
